entries.name: Soulterra
entries.content:
World Lore:
- Soulterra is a modern fantasy world, featuring a mix of medieval and modern elements, where magic exists and powerful royal families rule with authority.
- Males only make up 20 percent of the population on this planet and are considered rare. Females are much more plentiful.
- Human, Elven, and Beastmen races exist, Beastmen are the most numerous race besides Humans, Elves are the least numerous.
- Beastmen look largely like humans, but they have animal ears and tails, some may have furred arms and legs as well. There are many differeant types of beastmen and they have stronger instincts and senses compared to the other races
- Magic is largely uncommon among the population on Soulterra. Each of the royal families has a magic they specialize in.
- Soulterra is made up of one large continent, and a scattering of islands and atolls in the oceans. Besides the western portion, the entirety of the continent is bordered by a vast mountain range. It is home to 5 kingdoms and a scattering of nomadic tribes.

Kingdoms:
- The temperate lands of the Escalón kingdom lie at the center of the continent
- The wintry lands of the Étoile kingdom lie in the northern portion of the continent
- The lush desert lands of the Caelus kingdom lie in the southern portion of the continent
- The badlands surrounding the independent city of Souterraine lie in the eastern portion of the continent
- The pristine waters of the Terros kingdom lie in the western portion of the continent

entries.name: The Escalón Kingdom
entries.content:
The Escalón kingdom: The temperate lands of the Escalón kingdom lie in the center of the continent, surrounded by a a natural barrier of towering mountains. The Escalón kingdom as the center of the continent has neutral to good relations with the other kingdoms and uses it's central position to keep the other kingdoms friendly to each other, all respect the legend of the hero king who is said to have single handedly raised the mountain range that now surrounds the kingdom, some guess that this one legendary talent drained the magic from the Escalón bloodline, leaving them without magic. The Escalón capital serves as the central hub for most of the diplomatic talks among the kingdoms. The Escalón families estate is said to have been a collaboration among the royal families of the continent out of respect for the hero kings sheer power and might. Even now it's design is decades more advanced then any other building on the continent.
Royal family: The Escalón royal family consists of Johana Escalón, the queen; Quentin Escalón, the king; and Larissa Escalón, the crown princess.

entries.name: The Étoile Kingdom
entries.content:
The Étoile Kingdom: The wintry lands of the Étoile kingdom lies to the north of the Escalón kingdom's mountain range. The Étoile kingdom boasts amazing textiles due to the many furred animals in it's winter lands, and an abundance of meat, most of which they export in return for grains and vegetables. Due to low elven fertility they have a lower population compared to the other kingdoms, and few settlements besides the capital city.
Isdar Mithrim: The capital of the Étoile kingdom, Isdar Mithrim is quite secluded, few from the other kingdoms have the will to make the long trek there and the elves themselves are content to keep to themselves. Features a large amount of hot springs and uses geothermal energy to keep the streets warm. Occasionally the beautiful singing voice of the crown princess drifts through the air of the capital, her voice is said to calm people and weather alike. The weather over the capital is perpetually mild and pleasant.
Royal family: The royal family of the Étoile kingdom are the Ambrise, the Ambrise family consists of Elora Ambrise, the queen; Aaron Ambrise the king; and Lumina Ambrise, the crown princess;
Magic: Magic users make up 15% of the Étoile kingdoms population, a result of the high population of elves which are naturally sensitive to mana.

entries.name: The Caelus Kingdom
entries.content:
The Caelus Kingdom: The lush deserts of the Caelus kingdom lies to the south of the Escalón kingdom's mountain range. The Caelus kingdom prides itself on its crystal exports and the exotic specialties native to the desert. Due to high beastmen fertility they should have a higher population compared to the other kingdoms, however the necessity for settlements to be formed around crystal spires for access to water limits the maximum population.
Capital: The kingdom's capital, Indigo is built around the largest of the frost element crystal spires in the desert, making the temperature warm but largely bearable year round. Frost crystal spires naturally condense water from the hot desert air around them, this usually causes oasis's to form around their bases, a main source of water in the desert.
Clothing: Women in the Caelus Kingdom generally wear minimal clothing to combat the desert heat. Common attire includes lingerie, bikinis, and veils to shield them from the harsh sun.
Companion System: Exclusive to the Caelus Kingdom, it is a system for females to get closer to males, the females offer themselves submissively in exchange for pampering and coddling. It's popular among the females of the kingdom, particularly feline and canine beastmen, who like the hierarchy it enforces. Royalty cannot officially become companions due to their status, but many emulate the system by offering themselves to favored males. Their status ensures that these men cannot refuse their proposal, despite the inability to formally become companions due to their royal status.
Royal customs: The Caelus kingdom is technically a matriarchy, but many generations of languid queens have goaded their partners into taking their virginity's just before the wedding night, forcing a trial by combat, if the trial is failed the male is exiled if they win they get to rule. It is almost seen as a personal failure for the queen to have to actually rule. The position is largely ceremonial, many of the responsibilities of the royalty have long been delegated, and any corruption is dealt with via physical beatdown by the powerful royal family. The trial of combat consists of hand to hand combat against both the king and queen (They won't be trying too hard).
Royal family: The Caelus royal family rules the kingdom, the family consists of Beldar Caelus, the king; Cecile Caelus the queen; Neraia Caelus, the crown princess; and her 30 younger sisters. The Caelus royal family is very prolific.
Magic: Due to the high proportion of Beastmen in Caelus, magic users constitute only 1% of the kingdom's population. While Beastmen are less attuned to mana, they compensate with their natural physical prowess.

entries.name: The Terros Kingdom
entries.content:
The Terros Kingdom: The pristine waters of the Terros kingdom lie to the west of the Escalón kingdom's mountain range. The Terros kingdom prides itself on it's thriving maritime economy and exotic sea exports. Due to the sugarcane that grows within it's borders it is the primary source of sugar on the continent and a large exporter of sweet treats. Aside from that, it imports a significant amount of textiles from the Étoile kingdom that it then dyes and exports. A large part of it's territory is made up of lakes and rivers giving it the second least amount of territory on the continent.
Aequorea: The capital of the Terros kingdom, stretches from the royal lake to the ocean and is comparable in size to the Escalón royal capital, it's beaches are a renowned tourist spot and it's beautiful vista's make it the tourism capital of the world.
Royal Palace: The Unda family's estate is situated at the bottom of the royal lake at the edge of the capital city. It sits under a mana reinforced glass dome that sifts air directly from the surrounding water. There is no direct path into the royal palace, how the royal family gets in and out is a mystery only they know.
Royal family: The royal family of the Terros kingdom are the Unda, the Unda family consists of Delmar Unda, the king; Lucille Unda, the queen; Junah Unda, the crown princess; and 2 children that have yet to make a public appearance.

entries.name: The Independent City Souterraine
entries.content:
Badlands: The ever-dark badlands lie to the east of the Escalón kingdom's mountain range. It is named as such due to it's harsh and barren nature, and the ever present dark mana on the surface which chokes out normal flora. Souterraine is located deep in the badlands underneath the surface.
Souterraine: The Independent City of Souterraine is the premier technological capital of the world and the main entrance to the world spanning dungeon underneath Soulterra's surface that is theorized to go all the way down to the planets core. In sharp contrast to the ever-dark land above, the kingdoms capital is ever-bright due to the numerous mana crystals studded in the ceiling of the humongous underground cavern that houses the city, and the bio-luminescent flora that inhabit the dungeon and feed off it's mana.
General Info: Souterraine boasts great miners, the most amazing smiths, and the most powerful adventurers on the planet, necessary to support the adventurers that delve into the dungeon. Due to a lack of fertile land they import a lot of grains and vegetables from the nearby kingdoms, they are well supplied with meat however, due to the monsters in the dungeon. The other kingdoms are hesitant about trading for monster meat, they are interested in the other dungeon products however.
Structure: Souterraine is technically a democracy, the other kingdoms have representatives that can influence the city but the ruling family has final say.
Ruling family: The ruling family of Souterraine are the Tenebris, the Tenebris family has been staying hidden for the last 5 years, but missives still arrive on time to direct affairs in the city.
